routes.name: Residence registration certificate for EU citizens
Permanent residence registration certificate for an EU citizen

note: Slovenia, read on GOV.SI, the government's portal, on 2026-10-30. EU citizens need no visa or residence permit; after three months they obtain a residence registration certificate at the administrative unit where they live, on employment, self-employment, services, job search, study, family or means; it is issued for the stay intended, at most five years, and renewed on the same conditions; the Foreigners Act extends this to EEA citizens. After five years' lawful and continuous residence a permanent registration certificate may be issued for an unlimited period. The routes for third-country nationals (the single residence and work permit, the permit for self-employment, the permanent residence permit) are on infotujci.si, an information service the portal links to but which isn't the government's own, and the Foreigners Act on the legal register wasn't read, so none is written. Fees, decision times and naturalisation's count aren't on the page read.

sources.title: GOV.SI, Entry and residence
sources.said: For the first three months after entry, he or she may reside in Slovenia without residence registration. However, for a longer stay, EU citizens must obtain a residence registration certificate at the administrative unit in their area of residence ... The residence registration certificate is issued to EU citizens for the duration of their intended stay, or for a maximum period of five years. A residence registration certificate may be renewed under the same conditions as it was issued. ... A permanent registration certificate may be issued to an EU citizen for an unlimited period of time if he or she has resided in the Republic of Slovenia legally and continuously for five years. ... The provisions of the Foreigners Act applying to EU citizens also apply to the citizens of the Member States of the European Economic Area
